shared_elements: bearded male human figure in strict profile
elaborately curled/beaded beard rendered as rows of ringlets
curled hair mass at back of head
low-relief carving of a human figure facing right
stylised almond eye shown frontally in profile head
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile in low relief with the same highly conventional treatment of hair and beard as tightly ordered rows of bead-like curls, a curled hair mass at the nape, and a fitted cap, which is a specific and arbitrary shared convention rather than a generic 'human head'. The main difference in depicted content is scope and interaction: A shows only a single monumental head and shoulder, while B shows two full-length standing figures interacting, one extending a small round object toward the other, with garments, weapons and attributes that A does not show.
